Path 1, deliveryGOALS §1.4

ApplicationSets + progressive sync

One definition fanned out to every cluster, in waves rather than all at once.

WHAT IT IS

An Argo CD controller that generates Applications from generators (cluster list, label selector, Git directories, pull requests). Progressive sync rolls them out in ordered steps with health checks between.

WHAT SETS IT APART

It selects clusters by label, the cheapest route to a constraint vocabulary. It is a templating controller, not a scheduler: no health input, no rescheduling when a cluster disappears.

WHERE WE STAND

Trial progressive sync on one platform component across non-prod; use label selectors as the cluster interface from day one.

Argo CD docs; LinkedIn's canary pipeline talk, KubeCon NA 2026

TRIAL

ApplicationSets + progressive sync: One definition fanned out to every cluster, in waves rather than all at once. Where we stand: Trial progressive sync on one platform component across non-prod; use label selectors as the cluster interface from day one. Name the limit every time it comes up: placement that reacts to cluster health is Karmada or OCM territory, not this.
